title: After the Central restart, a root session's turns on an existing claim are all 'unadmitted', so its registered checks earn no credit
outcome: A root session whose claim and named root predate a host restart gets its later turns admitted to that claim, so a passing foreground test in the named root earns credit; or the host names the supported step (re-claim, re-name, new session) that restores admission.
acceptance: After the Central restart, a root session's turns on an existing claim are all 'unadmitted', so its registered checks earn no credit is done
disposal_reason: Not a defect, per Fable2 (#528, relayed by Engram::Opus in TermAl mailbox 37bcca97 #2281, 2026-11-24 04:42Z): 'unadmitted / cause unknown' is the normal label for every turn on this build, and a plain `cargo test` is observed but never credited. Credit comes only from a registered launcher run with --input commit from the named root on a clean committed input. Engram::Opus reruns that way.
